summary: Describes extended performance statistics for TCP, designed to use TCP's vantage point to diagnose problems in the network and in applications. It can help tell whether a slowdown comes from the sender, the receiver, or the network. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: TCP sits in the middle of every conversation and sees everything. This note lists the measurements it can report to find out who is slowing things down.
